cases.name: structural-method-active
cases.source: class View{m(a:i32[]):void{}}class Actual{m(a:i32[]):void{a.length=0;}}export function read(b:Actual,a:i32[],i:u32):i32{const v:View=b;const s:ReadSpan<i32>=readSpan(a,0,1);v.m(a);return s[i];}

cases.name: structural-method-after-use
cases.source: class View{m(a:i32[]):void{}}class Actual{m(a:i32[]):void{a.length=0;}}export function read(b:Actual,a:i32[],i:u32):i32{const v:View=b;const s:ReadSpan<i32>=readSpan(a,0,1);const x:i32=s[i];v.m(a);return x;}
